text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During lunch break, in the central 
courtyard, I stumbled upon El Condor Pasa 
and Grass Wonder playing around with 
something.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Perfect timing! Please referee our 
coin toss match!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The rules are simple! I flip a coin, and 
Grass guesses heads or tails, ya see!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Pardon the intrusion. El seems thrilled 
that she's learned how to flip a coin.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Could you hang out with me for a bit~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And with that, I ended up getting 
semi-forcibly dragged into their 
competition.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Fufufu, alright then, here I go-deeees!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Grass! Heads or tails, which is 
it?!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh my, which could it be? Tails?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Bzzzzt! It's heads! This match goes to El, 
yes--!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Fufufu! How about you next, Trainer-san!?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, shall we go another 
round~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Precisely because I was her Trainer, I 
knew. The fire of her competitive spirit 
had been ignited……!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Which one could it be!?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Heads, perhaps?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: No! It's tails!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Tails?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Boo!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
With this, it's 10 wins and 0 losses, 
baby!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Whether by a cruel twist of fate or divine 
whim, Grass Wonder suffered a major losing 
streak.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And as her Trainer, I could feel it. Her 
fighting spirit was blazing like a raging 
fire...!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...Lunch break is almost over, so shall we 
make this the last one?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
It's a once-in-a-lifetime showdown, yes!! 
Well then, here I gooo!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Huh!? W-Whoa, whoaa-whoa!!" his

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa fumbled the catch, 
revealing that the coin landed on tails.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Whoops, careful! I almost dropped it! Now 
then... heads or tails, which will it 
be?!"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ... ...This coin is hea—
choice_data_list: Signal with eye contact that it's tails.
Cheer her on with a "Do your best!"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: âHeads. This coin landed on heads.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The once-in-a-lifetime coin toss match 
ended in complete defeat for Grass Wonder.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I could really feel how much you were 
cheering for me, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Still... I realized that, at the end of 
the day, I have to win it on my own~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Later on, I happened to spot her borrowing 
a book titled "Probability" at the 
library.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Fufu, thank you very much, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... How about we switch things up 
a bit, then? Which one do you think it is, 
El~?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
At this point, don't you think you can 
tell if it's heads or tails just by the 
touch~?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I see, a battle of wits and mind games, is 
it?! Challenge accepted!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I think... it was tails!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Then I will... believe in El. That coin 
is... tails, right?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After a battle of wits, the 
once-in-a-lifetime coin toss concluded 
with Grass Wonder's victory.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, this might all be thanks to your 
cheering, Trainer-san~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Later on, coin tossing seemed to become a 
trend in the class, and I saw everyone 
flipping coins together.
